info.name: Uyir Health Partner Service
info.description:
Health Partner service: profiles, District → Block → Village location, referrals, wallet and withdrawals.

**Caller identity:** the API Gateway injects `x-user-id` and `x-user-role`. Here they are placeholders set from collection variables:
- `hpUserId` / `hpRole` — the Health Partner (role HP)
- `newHpUserId` — second Health Partner, used for the HP referral flow
- Folder 4 calls the internal API as userservice would (no identity headers - `/internal/v1` is never forwarded by the gateway)
- `adminUserId` / `adminRole` — ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN (locations + district APIs)

**Run order:** folders 1 → 7 run top to bottom as a full flow (Collection Runner works). IDs (district, block, village, referral code, …) are saved into collection variables as you go. Select the **Health Partner Service - local** environment before running. On re-runs change `hpUserId`, `newHpUserId`, `districtName`, `blockName` and `villageName` in the environment.

item.name: 1. Locations (District → Block → Village)
item.description: Location master. POST = ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN (admin headers). GET = any role (uses the HP headers). Names are unique (case-insensitive) within their parent, so change the names on re-runs or you'll get 400 "already exists".

item.name: 2. Health Partners
item.description: Role HP. The user id comes from the x-user-id header — never send it in the body.

request.description: Required: fullName, phone, districtId. Optional: blockId, villageId (needs blockId), email, dateOfBirth (YYYY-MM-DD), gender (MALE|FEMALE|OTHER), addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, pincode, profilePhotoUrl, referralCode.

exec: pm.test("block only, no village", () => pm.expect(json.blockId && json.villageId === null).to.be.true);

request.description: Referred by the first Health Partner. Credits ₹10 to the referrer in the same transaction.

item.name: 3. Profile
item.description: Role HP. This service is the owner of all Health Partner profile data.

request.description: Location is replaced as a group: send districtId with optional blockId / villageId. Omitted or null block / village are cleared.

item.name: 4. Referrals
item.description:
Citizen referrals. The patient enters the HP's code when creating their profile in the app; userservice then calls the internal API below (no gateway, no token - private network only):

1. `GET /internal/v1/referral-codes/:code?referredUserId=` - is the code valid for this patient (signup form check)
2. `POST /internal/v1/referrals` - patient signed up with the code: **PENDING**, no reward
3. `POST /internal/v1/referrals/complete` - patient's own ABHA linked: **COMPLETED**, ₹10 to the HP's wallet
4. `POST /internal/v1/referrals/cancel` - patient erased their account before linking: **CANCELLED**

Every call is idempotent (userservice retries). The old HP-called `POST /api/v1/referrals` is gone - an HP can no longer claim a reward by naming a user id.

exec: // Fresh patients per run - a user can only ever be referred once.
pm.test("PENDING, completedAt null", () => pm.expect(json.status === "PENDING" && json.completedAt === null).to.be.true);
pm.test("CITIZEN, reward ₹10 to come", () => pm.expect(json.referredType === "CITIZEN" && Number(json.rewardAmount) === 10).to.be.true);

item.name: Dashboard: 1 pending, nothing paid for it yet
Cancel a completed referral → left COMPLETED
5. Payments
item.description: Role HP. Wallet is credited ₹10 per referral. A bank account is required before withdrawal.

request.description: Saving again updates the existing account (one per Health Partner).
Paginated Health Partners in a district. Optional filters (enable in Params): blockId, villageId, status (ACTIVE | INACTIVE), search (name or phone). limit max 100.

exec: pm.test("totals add up", () => pm.expect(json.total === json.active + json.inactive).to.be.true);
pm.test("has block breakdown", () => pm.expect(Array.isArray(json.blocks) && json.blocks.every(b => Array.isArray(b.villages))).to.be.true);

request.description: Totals and counts per block and per village, including blocks and villages with 0.

item.name: 7. Validation Checks
item.description: Negative tests - every request here is expected to fail with 400.

exec: pm.test("message: blockId is required", () => pm.expect(json.message.includes("blockId is required")).to.be.true);
pm.test("message: District not found", () => pm.expect(json.message.includes("District not found")).to.be.true);
pm.test("message: Insufficient wallet balance", () => pm.expect(json.message.includes("Insufficient wallet balance")).to.be.true);
